newsitem.title: GERMANY: Rexrodt greets EU adoption of jobs plan.
newsitem.headline: Rexrodt greets EU adoption of jobs plan.

text.p: German Economics Minister Guenter Rexrodt said the resolution on growth and employment adopted by European Union leaders on Monday underscores the need for monetary stability and sound public finances.

The statement also stresses the need for structural reforms in the labour market, social security system and taxation, and it challenges employers and labour to give due consideration to the jobless and to job security, Rexrodt said in a statement.
"Employment policy responsibility remains in the national sphere," Rexrodt said, adding that it could be complemented by closer cooperation at the European level.

The important point is that the stability pact adopted in Dublin was approved without modifications, and that no provision was made to use currency exchange rates as an employment policy instrument, he said.
"This would be as mistaken as a new spending programme," he said. Spending discipline must be maintained on the European as well as on the national level, he said.
